finding: SETTLED: a vetoing BeforeDropOrPaste (Cancel = True) SUPPRESSES a drag-drop drop, the same way it suppresses a keyboard Ctrl+V paste (esq.17). dragdrop_baseline (gVetoDrop False): SourceBox MouseDown(s) -> TargetBox BeforeDropOrPaste(Cancel False->False; Action=3 [fmActionDragDrop -- distinct from Action=2 for a keyboard paste]; Effect=3; data_object=present) -> TargetBox Change(value=OxFormsDragSeed) -> TargetBox Enter -> SourceBox Change(emptied) i.e. a MOVE. dragdrop_veto (gVetoDrop True): SourceBox MouseDown(s) -> TargetBox BeforeDropOrPaste(Cancel False->True; Action=3) -> SourceBox Change(emptied); NO TargetBox Change -- the target drop is suppressed. CONSUMED FACT (esq.4f8): honor the drag-drop BeforeDropOrPaste Cancel=True veto by suppressing the target insert + Change, deferring the insert until the Cancel readback folds back (the same two-stage path as the keyboard paste, esq.17 -- reduce_drop_or_paste currently inserts synchronously before BeforeDropOrPaste). NON-CLAIM / WRINKLE: the vetoed intra-form MOVE-drag still emptied the SOURCE (SourceBox Change to empty in both scenarios) -- that is the SOURCE control's move behavior, NOT the drop-target path OxForms models (reduce_drop_or_paste only inserts into the target); not consumed.
